_comment: marble_trapdoor: the walkway trapdoor's moving parts, an arc sector of the ring for the hole marble_build cuts on a pier in TRAPDOOR_BEARINGS (four lane cells, r 48.05 to the wall foot, over its 6 m pit). Origin the deck point at r 53.989 (mid-hole) on the hole's centre bearing, y 0 the deck, +X radial out, +Z toward increasing bearing. TrapdoorFrame: near-black iron rim inside the hole, 0.35 deep, its outer edge the cut itself, its inner edge the lip arc r 48.33 and the wall arc r 59.648 (0.28 m rim; 0.35 at the bay corners) between radial sides, five knuckles on each hinge arc. TrapdoorLeaf00 (inner, hinged on the lip arc) and TrapdoorLeaf01 (outer, on the wall arc): two 0.15 m stone sectors meeting at a seam arc r 53.869, their flags on the lane's own cell grid, five iron strap hinges and an iron lip on the free edge, iron undersides; node origin is the hinge AXIS, the chord through the hinge arc's ends at the flap's bottom arris (r 48.118 / 59.381), local +X along it, local +Z toward the free edge: +90 deg about local X hangs it (to 5.9 m). TrapdoorSpikes: pale stone spikes on a 0.9 m grid over the pit floor (y -6.0), tips -5.15..-4.9, 0.45 m clear of the axes. NO colliders: the scene gives the flaps their bodies.
